summary: A Knightsbridge office and compliance certificates are strengths, but a valuation form that appears to be missing and a dead registration link cost you vendors.

findings.problem: The valuation section says Simply fill out the form but no form appears, and the Get in touch form shows flattened labels with no visible fields or submit button.
findings.cost: Vendors who want a valuation cannot request one.
findings.fix: A working valuation and enquiry form.

findings.problem: The HMRC AML registration number links to #, and the header email link has an empty mailto target.
findings.cost: A dead compliance link and a broken email link weaken trust.

findings.problem: A friendly and professional team at your service appears twice, Read more is the link text on all four listings, and the Nearest branch field lists only one option.
findings.cost: Repeated lines and vague links make the page feel generic.

findings.problem: The page claims over 65 years of combined local knowledge and The Best Price with no named agents, sales figures, reviews or awards.
findings.cost: Vendors choose on proof and see none.
findings.fix: Named agents, reviews and sales figures.

redesign: A working valuation form with WhatsApp.
Named agents, reviews and sales figures.
